open.ask: Does the application revisit a sample within one pass over the set (a draw with replacement), or touch each exactly once per pass (a permutation)?

at_scale.measure: share of the set never read; share of touches that re-read a path

open.question: selection
open.settles: a second pass over the set (a repeat decides it), or the corpus size: fewer than 3 candidates refutes a draw with replacement (no repeat in 3 touches would have probability below 0.05)
